# Jay Lewis Realtor

> REALTOR® with RE/MAX Excellence serving buyers and sellers in Edmonton,
> Alberta, Canada and the surrounding communities of Sherwood Park,
> St. Albert, Spruce Grove, Stony Plain, Fort Saskatchewan, Beaumont,
> Leduc, Devon, Morinville, and Onoway. Specializes in new-construction
> buyer representation, backed by 20+ years of residential construction
> experience.

Jay Lewis provides residential real estate services including home buying
representation, home selling and listing services, free home evaluations,
new-construction buyer representation, and local market guidance across
the greater Edmonton region.

Contact: jay@jaysells.ca
Website: https://jaysells.ca/
New construction: https://jaysells.ca/new-construction/

## Key facts
- REALTOR® with RE/MAX Excellence, based in Edmonton, Alberta
- Spent 20+ years in residential construction (framing, renovations,
  complete contract builds) before becoming a REALTOR®
- Specializes in representing buyers purchasing new-construction homes:
  evaluating builders, lots, specifications, upgrades, contracts,
  walkthroughs and deficiencies
- Serves both home buyers and sellers
- Coverage area: Edmonton and the surrounding communities listed above
- Offers free, no-obligation home evaluations for sellers
- Buyer-agent compensation terms vary by transaction and should be
  discussed and documented before a buyer enters an agreement
